non_compensable_gates: zero false SUCCESS_VERIFIED claims in the frozen in-domain corpus
zero duplicate recipient logical effects for one idempotency key
zero silent loss of an acknowledged durable outbox state within the declared storage model
zero host authorization widening across cell, grantee, function or capability kind
zero post-revocation host admission in non-overlapping tests
zero silent downgrade to a weaker or unqualified cryptographic profile
zero plaintext, raw secret or capability secret in telemetry
every unresolved outcome remains UNKNOWN or INCOMPLETE
zero false all-required group-completion claims when any required recipient child is missing, duplicated, unknown or unverified
zero receipt laundering across recipient commitments
zero unauthorized child recipients relative to the externally pinned manifest
zero post-removal acceptance for messages created after the effective removal epoch
zero unauthorized late-joiner historical-decryption acceptance under the declared policy
reporting_rules: Do not combine hard safety gates with performance in a weighted score.
Do not equate transport ACK, server acceptance, DHT publication or relay receipt with recipient delivery.
Report capability unsupported, not implemented, unmeasured and failed as distinct statuses; never encode unsupported as zero cost or zero leakage.
Compare candidates only where protocol semantics, security guarantees and receipt semantics are matched.
Publish per-platform, per-workload and per-failure-domain results; do not hide regressions in averages.
A finite corpus result is limited to that corpus, environment, candidate build and stated threat model.
Group fan-out is reported per recipient and as an explicit aggregate; one recipient receipt cannot establish complete group delivery.

A v0.1 fan-out structural verdict is not a cryptographically verified group delivery; report it as ALL_REQUIRED_RECEIPT_CLAIMS_CONSISTENT until manifest, membership, receipt signatures, principal independence and trusted time are authenticated.
Measure group-level CPU, peak memory, storage, network and physical energy per recipient-verified effect and per fully verified group send; publish failures and partial fan-outs separately.
Evaluate recipient commitments against dictionary attacks, cross-epoch linkability and small-group membership inference; do not expose raw rosters.

For ratchet-capable candidates, measure the vulnerable message set after injected compromise, messages and bytes until post-compromise healing, elapsed healing time, and sessions not healed by the declared horizon. These depend on peer message schedules and offline behavior; report asymmetric and non-responsive peer cases.

For candidates without a ratcheting key-agreement design, mark post-compromise healing metrics NOT_SUPPORTED. Never encode not-supported cryptographic properties as zero latency or zero vulnerable messages.

group_fanout_semantics.parent_fanout_identity: stable per group send; not a delivery receipt or bearer credential
group_fanout_semantics.recipient_child_identity: one stable logical_operation_id per required recipient; multiple transport attempt IDs may exist for retries/routes
group_fanout_semantics.recipient_set_binding: versioned membership/epoch snapshot plus redacted recipient-set commitment; no raw roster in public qualification traces
group_fanout_semantics.child_success: Target product semantics: recipient admission, one inbox commit, decryption verification and a cryptographically verified recipient-specific receipt. Current v0.1 verifier checks event and digest binding consistency, not receipt signatures.
group_fanout_semantics.aggregate_complete: Target product semantics: COMPLETE_VERIFIED only when every required child has a cryptographically verified receipt by a trusted deadline. Current v0.1 tool reports ALL_REQUIRED_RECEIPT_CLAIMS_CONSISTENT only; manifest authority, membership truth, receipt signatures, principal independence and trusted time are not verified.
group_fanout_semantics.partial_and_unknown: PARTIAL, UNKNOWN, INCOMPLETE, EXPIRED and FAILED remain distinct; unknown child outcomes never count as successful delivery. The trace schema includes PARTIAL as an explicit terminal disposition.
group_fanout_semantics.threshold_policy: all_required_recipients by default; any quorum/threshold override must be explicit, user-visible and bound to a separately authenticated policy snapshot
group_fanout_semantics.device_semantics: declare whether the child outcome is per account, per device or for a required device set; one device receipt never implies all-device sync
group_fanout_semantics.membership_semantics: predeclare removal, late-join and historical-decrypt policy by membership epoch; evaluate each separately
group_fanout_semantics.per_recipient_outcome: PRD_D = required recipient children with authenticated receipts by trusted deadline D / all required recipient children from admitted fanout intents. Missing child traces remain in the denominator and count as failures or unresolved outcomes, never disappear.
group_fanout_semantics.complete_group_outcome: CGDR_D = admitted fanouts whose every required child in the independently authenticated frozen membership snapshot has an authenticated receipt by trusted deadline D / all admitted fanout intents.
group_fanout_semantics.snapshot_freeze_point: Freeze the exact membership epoch and recipient set at fanout-intent admission, before sending, retries, delivery observations or terminal outcomes.
group_fanout_semantics.recipient_unit_semantics: Each manifest declares ACCOUNT or DEVICE. ACCOUNT means account-level acceptance only; DEVICE means one child per required device. An account-level child never implies every device is synchronized.
group_fanout_semantics.recipient_set_authority: The parent manifest hash pins bytes, not authority. A separate trusted membership/policy root must establish that the declared recipient set is complete and authorized.
group_fanout_semantics.current_v0_1_claim: Structural/causal consistency only: ALL_REQUIRED_RECEIPT_CLAIMS_CONSISTENT. No receipt signature, manifest authority, membership truth, principal independence or trusted deadline verification.
